school: 传播工程与一生调度的体系：以'老妪能解'把表达的完成定义在接收端，以'为时而著'把写作挂接当期公共事务，以'惟歌生民病'的现场取证为发声提供证据质量，以讽谕/闲适双轨对冲批评风险，以江州之贬完成把私人苦难翻译成公共形式的转化，以'中隐'设计低敞口的中间生态位，以多副本+公开目录经营跨期存活，以显式的'够'函数买断独立性，以九老会重建晚年秩序——把'达则兼济，穷则独善'从格言改造成一生的调度协议
historical_significance: 白居易（772-846），字乐天，号香山居士，唐代最伟大的现实主义诗人之一、新乐府运动的主要倡导者：贞元十六年进士，元和年间任左拾遗时'有阙必规，有违必谏'，作《新乐府》五十首、《秦中吟》十首直刺宫市、赋税等时弊，主张'文章合为时而著，歌诗合为事而作'；815年因武元衡案越职言事贬江州司马，在浔阳江头写出《琵琶行》；后任杭州刺史（筑堤蓄水，撰《钱塘湖石记》）、苏州刺史，晚年以太子宾客、太子少傅分司东都，退居洛阳履道里二十余年，与胡杲、吉旼等结九老会，自号香山居士、出资修香山寺，846年卒，葬于香山；他与元稹并称'元白'，与刘禹锡并称'刘白'，其诗'禁省、观寺、邮候墙壁之上无不书，王公妾妇、牛童马走之口无不道'，并远传新罗、日本——839年自编《白氏文集》六十本分藏庐山东林寺、苏州南禅院、洛阳圣善寺，是中唐文学作品传播与保存工程的巅峰；其'老妪能解'的写作标准与'兼济/独善'的阶段调度，至今仍是传播学与人生策略的经典范本
historical_significance_en: Bai Juyi (772-846), courtesy name Letian, styled Layman of Incense Mountain, one of the greatest realist poets of the Tang and the leading voice of the New Yuefu movement: a jinshi of 800, as remembrancer in the Yuanhe years he 'rectified every lapse, remonstrated at every breach,' writing the fifty New Yuefu and ten Qinzhong Chants against the palace market, the tax burden and the abuses of the day, on the doctrine that 'essays must be written for the present hour, songs composed for actual events'; in 815, punished for speaking beyond his office in the Wu Yuanheng case, he was demoted to Marshal of Jiangzhou, where on the Xunyang River he wrote the Song of the Pipa; later prefect of Hangzhou (raising the lake dike, leaving the Qiantang Record) and of Suzhou, in his last years Junior Guest and Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent divided to the Eastern Capital, living more than twenty years at Ludao Lane in Luoyang, forming the Nine Elders, funding the repair of Incense-Mountain Temple, dying in 846 and buried on the Incense Mountain; paired with Yuan Zhen as 'Yuan-Bai' and with Liu Yuxi as 'Liu-Bai,' his poems were written 'on the walls of the palace and the temples and the post-stations, in the mouths of princes and concubines, herd-boys and grooms,' and traveled to Silla and Japan — in 839 he compiled the sixty fascicles of the Bai Collection and stored them at the Eastern Grove Temple on Mount Lu, the Zen Temple at Suzhou and the Shengshan Temple at Luoyang, a peak of preservation engineering for literature in the Tang; his standard of 'the old woman's understanding' and his dispatch protocol between aid and withdrawal remain classic models of communication and of life strategy
unique_thinking: 白居易思维模式的独特性在于六条主线的合成：第一，'接收端定义完成'——老妪能解的验收器把作品价值锚定在接收者而非创作者，这是传播学出现前一千二百年的工程化表达；第二，'现场取证优先'——惟歌生民病，只写眼见耳闻可指认的苦难，用取证质量而非感情总量支撑发声的合法性；第三，'风险分层的组合设计'——讽谕与闲适双轨出自同一支笔，使批评行为可以在安全资产的滋养下长期持续；第四，'生态位工程'——中隐不是退隐而是设计：在体制内找到既有资源又低敞口的中间位置，把省下的风险预算投入长期作品；第五，'跨期资产化'——多地域多副本加公开目录，把身后名当作生前可投资的组合来经营，并选择可传诵形态以最大化复制介质；第六，'显式的自我调度'——把'达则兼济穷则独善'写成带触发条件的协议，以客观处境而非情绪决定执行模式；六线共同指向一件事：把人生当作一个需要长期管理的传播与风险系统，而不是一场需要即兴发挥的表演
unique_thinking_en: The distinctiveness of Bai Juyi's thinking is a synthesis of six lines. First, completion defined at the receiving end: the old woman's understanding anchors a work's value in the receiver, not the maker — an engineering of communication twelve centuries before the discipline. Second, evidence before feeling: singing only the people's ills, writing only what he had seen and could point to, grounding speech in the quality of proof rather than the total of emotion. Third, a risk-layered portfolio: satire and repose from the same pen, letting criticism be sustained long-term on the nourishment of safe assets. Fourth, niche engineering: middle reclusion is not retreat but design — a position inside the institution with resources and low exposure, the saved risk budget invested in long works. Fifth, capitalizing across time: many copies, many regions, an open catalogue — posthumous fame managed as a portfolio investable in life, with chantable forms chosen to maximize the media of copying. Sixth, explicit self-dispatch: 'aid when prosperous, withdraw when straitened' written as a protocol with objective triggers, execution mode decided by circumstance, never by mood; the six lines share one direction: treating a life as a communication-and-risk system to be managed long-term, not a performance to be improvised
civilization_zh: 九世纪初的唐帝国——元和中兴与牛李党争之间的长安：新乐府的歌辞贴在邮候墙壁上，宫市的强买发生在街市，琵琶声落在浔阳江头的秋夜；老妪解诗的门槛、留司官的闲署、香山寺的钟声与履道里的五亩园同属一个诗人；一个'惟歌生民病'的谏官，用一场贬谪、一道湖堤、六十本分藏三寺的文集，把'兼济'与'独善'活成了一生的调度表——他的诗在千年的时间里被童子与胡儿继续传唱，成为汉语世界里被复制最多的文本之一
civilization_en: The Tang empire of the early ninth century — Chang'an between the Yuanhe revival and the Niu-Li strife: the songs of the New Yuefu pasted on the walls of post-stations, the palace market's forced purchases in the streets, the pipa sounding on an autumn night by the Xunyang River; the old woman's threshold of understanding, the idle office of the Liusi, the bell of Incense-Mountain Temple and the five-acre garden of Ludao Lane belonged to one poet; a remembrancer who 'sang only the people's ills' — with one exile, one lake dike, sixty fascicles stored in three temples — turned aid and withdrawal into the dispatch sheet of a lifetime; his poems go on being sung by children and barbarian boys across a thousand years, among the most copied texts in the world of Chinese letters

cross_references.description_zh: 白居易与董仲舒是'知识分子如何影响权力'的两条路径：董仲舒以系统性经学建构为汉武帝提供统治意识形态——用一套理论体系置换国家的话语基础设施；白居易以讽谕诗直接挂接当朝具体时弊——用单点叙事冲击决策者的良知与舆论；一个从顶层设计意义系统，一个从底层取证推动个案，共同命题是'写作必须抵达有处置权的人'——两者的合力构成中国传统中'文以载道'的两翼。
cross_references.description_en: Bai Juyi and Dong Zhongshu are two paths of how the lettered man moves power: Dong built a systematic classical learning that supplied Emperor Wu with a ruling ideology — replacing the state's infrastructure of discourse with one theoretical system; Bai wrote satirical poems hooked to the concrete abuses of the reigning court — striking the conscience of deciders and public opinion with single-point narratives; one designs the meaning-system from the top, one pushes cases from the ground up with evidence; the shared proposition is 'writing must reach the hands with power over the matter' — together the two wings of the Chinese tradition of 'writing that carries the Way.'

cross_references.description_zh: 白居易与武则天是'在高风险宫廷中求存续'的对照：武则天以夺取最高权力为路径，把全部身份押在皇位上，代价是被整个官僚系统的敌意包围；白居易以'中隐'为路径，主动降低权力敞口，把身份分散到诗人、刺史、居士等多个低风险角色上；一个证明权力的顶点可以由非常之人登临，一个证明持续的影响力可以在权力顶点之外实现——两人共同暴露了同一系统的两面：不进则危，进则更危。
cross_references.description_en: Bai Juyi and Wu Zetian are a contrast in surviving a high-risk court: Wu took the summit of power itself as her path, staking her whole identity on the throne, at the cost of being surrounded by the enmity of the entire bureaucracy; Bai took 'middle reclusion' as his, deliberately lowering his exposure to power and dispersing his identity across low-risk roles — poet, prefect, layman; one proved the summit can be reached by the extraordinary, the other that lasting influence can be had outside the summit; between them they expose both faces of the same system: not advancing is peril, and advancing is more perilous still.

cross_references.description_zh: 白居易与司马迁是'逆境转化为作品'的两大原型：司马迁受宫刑后以'究天人之际'的宏大史著完成转化——把耻辱铸进通史的骨架；白居易贬江州后以琵琶女的镜像完成转化——把迁谪翻译成普遍的沦落；两人都在坠落的最深处找到了'比自我更大的容器'，并以作品立碑而非以申诉翻案——中国文学史上最重要的两部'至暗时刻之书'，一个向历史求广度，一个向他人求深度。
cross_references.description_en: Bai Juyi and Sima Qian are the two great archetypes of adversity converted into work: Sima Qian, after castration, completed his conversion in a grand history 'probing what lies between heaven and man' — casting disgrace into the skeleton of a general history; Bai, fallen to Jiangzhou, completed his in the mirror of the pipa player — translating banishment into a universal exile; both at the deepest fall found 'a vessel larger than the self' and set the fall's monument in a work, not an appeal — the two great books of the darkest hour in Chinese letters, one seeking breadth in history, one seeking depth in another person.

cross_references.description_zh: 白居易与晏阳初是'以受众为锚的传播者'的隔代同调：白居易令老妪解诗、不解则易之，把诗写给牛童马走；晏阳初在定县以农民的识字与生活为教材设计平民教育，把知识写给'目不识丁者'；两人都拒绝以同行叹服为标准，都把'接收完成'定义为表达的完成——一个在唐诗中实现了最大规模的口语传播，一个在现代中国实现了最大规模的乡村识字——跨越一千一百年的同一传播伦理。
cross_references.description_en: Bai Juyi and James Yen are communicators of different eras anchored on the same star: Bai had the old woman expound his poems and rewrote what she missed, writing for herd-boys and grooms; Yen in Ding County built mass education from the literacy and life of peasants, writing knowledge for those who could not read; both refused the admiration of peers as the standard and defined 'reception complete' as the completion of expression — one achieving the largest oral circulation in Tang poetry, the other the largest rural literacy drive in modern China — one ethic of communication across eleven hundred years.

modes.name_en: The Method of the Old Woman's Understanding
modes.domain_zh: 白居易给自己定了诗歌史上最苛刻的一条验收标准：惠洪《冷斋夜话》载，'白乐天每作诗，令一老妪解之，问曰：解否？妪曰解，则录之；不解，则易之'——他不是把诗写给同僚与考官看，而是写给识字最少的人看，并且用真人当验收器：念给不识字的老妇人听，她说懂了才定稿，说不懂就重写；这不是降低标准，而是换了标准的锚点——主流文人以'同行是否叹服'为锚，白居易以'目标读者是否真的接收'为锚；结果他的诗'童子解吟长恨曲，胡儿能唱琵琶篇'，元稹说他诗'二十年间，禁省、观寺、邮候墙壁之上无不书，王公妾妇、牛童马走之口无不道'——传播学早在一千二百年前就被他做成了工程：把'表达的完成'定义为'接收的完成'，用最不宽容的听众当测试用例，宁可重写也不空转
modes.domain_en: Bai Juyi set himself the harshest acceptance standard in the history of poetry: as Huihong's Cold Lodge Night Talks records, 'Whenever Bai Letian wrote a poem, he had an old woman expound it, asking: do you understand? If she said she understood, he kept it; if not, he changed it' — he wrote not for colleagues and examiners but for the least-lettered reader, and used a real person as the acceptance test: read the poem aloud to an illiterate woman, keep it only if she understood, rewrite if she did not; this was not a lower standard but a moved anchor — mainstream literati anchored on 'do peers admire it,' Bai Juyi anchored on 'has the intended reader actually received it'; the result was that 'children could sing the Song of Everlasting Sorrow and barbarian boys could chant the Song of the Pipa,' and Yuan Zhen wrote that within twenty years his poems were copied 'on the walls of palace and temple and the post-stations, in the mouths of princes and concubines, herd-boys and grooms'; a millennium and two centuries ago he made communication an engineering discipline: define 'expression complete' as 'reception complete,' take the least forgiving listener as the test case, and rather rewrite than let a verse idle
modes.source_chapter: 惠洪《冷斋夜话》卷一：'白乐天每作诗，令一老妪解之，问曰：解否？妪曰解，则录之；不解，则易之'；白居易《与元九书》自述其诗流布之广与'篇篇无空文，句句必尽规'的写作准则；元稹《白氏长庆集序》：'二十年间，禁省、观寺、邮候墙壁之上无不书，王公妾妇、牛童马走之口无不道'；唐宣宗吊白居易诗'童子解吟长恨曲，胡儿能唱琵琶篇'；其《新乐府》序自明'其辞质而径，欲见之者易谕也；其言直而切，欲闻之者深诫也'
modes.key_quote_zh: 老妪曰解，则录之；不解，则易之——表达的完成不是写完，而是被接收
modes.key_quote_en: "If she understood, he kept it; if not, he changed it — expression is finished not when written, but when received."
process_zh: 先于动笔之前定下'为谁而写'：不要以同行与上级为默认受众——明确列出真正的目标读者（要被说服的人、要被帮助的人），一切标准从他们出发
找到你的'老妪'：在目标受众中选一位最不宽容、最不迁就的真人当验收器——越不了解你的背景，测试越有效
以'能否复述'为通过线：不要问'好不好'——问对方能否用自己的话讲出你要传达的那件事；讲不出即未通过
未通过就重写而不是辩解：把'对方没懂'归因于作品而不是读者——宁可多改三稿，不让一件作品空转；输出的价值只存在于接收端
process_en: Fix 'for whom' before the first stroke: do not default to peers and superiors as the audience — name the real intended readers (those to be persuaded, those to be helped), and let every standard start from them
Find your old woman: pick from the target audience the least forgiving, least obliging real person as the acceptance test — the less they know your background, the more the test is worth
Make 'can they retell it' the passing line: do not ask 'is it good' — ask whether they can state in their own words the one thing you meant to convey; if not, it fails

Rewrite rather than argue when it fails: charge 'they did not understand' to the work, not the reader — rather rework three drafts than let a piece idle; an output's value exists only at the receiving end
representative_cases_zh: 《新乐府》五十首的'辞质而径'：每首自加小序点明题旨（如《卖炭翁》'苦宫市也'），语言直白到不看注释也能读懂——这是给自己作品内置说明书
《长恨歌》的雅俗两层：叙事主干人人能懂，'在天愿作比翼鸟'的警句人人能诵——通俗不等于浅薄，是被接收后的深度
诗题即摘要：白居易诗题常自带完整信息（'自河南经乱，关内阻饥，兄弟离散，各在一处，因望月有感，聊书所怀'）——标题先完成第一次接收
representative_cases_en: The 'plain and direct' diction of the fifty New Yuefu poems: each carries its own preface stating the point (as 'The Charcoal Seller: the sufferings of the palace market'), language legible without commentary — a manual built into the work itself
The two layers of the Song of Everlasting Sorrow: a narrative spine anyone can follow and couplets anyone can recite — the popular is not the shallow, but depth after reception

The title as abstract: Bai Juyi's titles often carry the whole information ('Scattered brothers, each in a place, on famine in Guannei after the disorders of Henan...') — the title performs the first reception
modern_applications_zh: 产品文案的'老妪测试'：发布前把说明拿给一位完全不懂行的用户看，让她复述产品做什么、怎么用——复述失败就改文案，不怪用户
技术方案的'两层表达'：给决策层的一页纸（结论+影响+选项）与给工程群的附录（细节+依据）分层写作——用同一素材服务两种接收能力
演讲的'复述检查'：散场时随机问一位听众'今天主要讲什么'——答案与你的核心论点一致才算讲完；不一致，责任在你
modern_applications_en: The old-woman test for product copy: before release, give the instructions to a user who knows nothing of the field and have her retell what the product does and how; if the retelling fails, change the copy, not the user

Two-layer expression for technical proposals: a one-page sheet for decisions (conclusion, impact, options) with an appendix for the engineers (detail, evidence) — one body of material serving two capacities of reception
The retelling check after a talk: ask a random listener on the way out 'what was the main point today'; it counts as delivered only if the answer matches your thesis — if not, the fault is yours

modes.category: 方法论/介入时务的写作
modes.domain_zh: 《与元九书》中白居易立下他全部写作的总纲：'文章合为时而著，歌诗合为事而作'——文章应当为当下的时代而写，诗歌应当为具体的事而作；这句话在'为艺术而艺术'与'为功名而写作'之外开出第三条路：写作的对象不是审美也不是个人前程，而是'此时此刻正在发生的公共事务'；他的《新乐府》五十首、《秦中吟》十首几乎每首对应一件当朝时事：《卖炭翁》刺宫市强买、《观刈麦》写赋税重压、《轻肥》结句'是岁江南旱，衢州人食人'——把一桩具体灾难钉进一句诗；他证明：写作者的效能不取决于才华总量，而取决于作品与'当下'的挂接密度——一个社会的问题清单，就是写作者的任务清单；时效不是妥协，而是让作品拥有'事件级'力量的来源
modes.domain_en: In the Letter to Yuan the Ninth, Bai Juyi laid down the master principle of all his writing: 'Essays must be written for the present hour; songs must be composed for actual events' — writing aimed not at beauty for its own sake nor at personal advancement, but at a third thing: the public affairs happening right now; his fifty New Yuefu and ten Qinzhong Chants answer, nearly every one, to a current event of the reigning court: The Charcoal Seller strikes at the palace market's forced purchases, Watching the Wheat Harvest at the crushing tax burden, and Lightness and Fat closes on the line 'In this year drought in Jiangnan; in Quzhou the people ate men' — a specific disaster nailed into a single verse; he proved: a writer's power depends not on the total of talent but on the density of the work's attachment to the present — a society's list of problems is the writer's list of assignments; timeliness is not a compromise but the source of an event-grade force in the work
modes.source_chapter: 白居易《与元九书》：'文章合为时而著，歌诗合为事而作'；'补察时政，泄导人情'的写作功能论；'上以补察时政，下以泄导人情……然则'文章合为时而著，歌诗合为事而作'，是也'；《新乐府》序：'首句标其目，卒章显其志'；《秦中吟》十首序意（'贞元、元和之际，予在长安，闻见之间，有足悲者，因直歌其事'）；《卖炭翁》题注'苦宫市也'；《轻肥》'是岁江南旱，衢州人食人'
modes.key_quote_zh: 文章合为时而著，歌诗合为事而作——作品的力量来自与'当下'的挂接密度
modes.key_quote_en: "Essays for the present hour, songs for actual events — a work's force is the density of its attachment to the present."
process_zh: 建立'时事问题清单'：定期列出你所在领域此刻最刺眼的具体问题——不是宏大议题，而是有当事人、有细节、有数字的具体事件
为清单上的每一项找'当事人细节'：不到现场就写不出《卖炭翁》——获取第一手的细节（对话、场景、数字），拒绝只靠转述
让作品'首句标目、卒章显志'：开头点明问题，结尾给出立场——不要让读者猜你在说什么，也不要只呈现不表态
把作品送到'能改变事的人'面前：白居易的诗首要读者是皇帝与执政者——你的产出应流向有处置权的人，而不是只在同温层流通
process_en: Keep a list of present problems: regularly name the most glaring concrete issues in your field at this hour — not grand topics but specific events with persons, details and numbers
Find the concrete person behind each item: without the scene there is no Charcoal Seller — seek first-hand detail (dialogue, scene, figures) and refuse to work from hearsay alone
Mark the theme in the first line, state the intent in the last: open by naming the problem, close by taking a stand — let no reader guess what you mean, and never present without a position

Carry the work to those who can change the matter: Bai Juyi's first readers were the emperor and the ministers — let your output flow to the hands with power over the matter, not only within the warm circle of peers
representative_cases_zh: 《卖炭翁》：'可怜身上衣正单，心忧炭贱愿天寒'——宫市制度对底层盘剥的完整叙事，题注直接写明'苦宫市也'，呈给决策者
《轻肥》的结尾刀法：全篇写宦官内臣宴饮之奢，末句突然落'是岁江南旱，衢州人食人'——用结构本身完成控诉
《与元九书》的理论反身：他把这套主张写成系统文论上呈——写作方法论本身也是'为时而著'的一部分
representative_cases_en: The Charcoal Seller: 'Poor man, his clothes are thin, yet he prays the weather colder for the price of charcoal' — a full narrative of the palace market's plunder of the lowest, its title-note naming the abuse plainly, presented to the deciders

The closing blade of Lightness and Fat: a whole poem on the eunuchs' lavish feast, and the last line falls — 'this year drought in Jiangnan, in Quzhou the people ate men' — the indictment performed by structure itself
The reflexive theory of the Letter to Yuan the Ninth: he wrote the doctrine up as a systematic essay — the writing method itself a part of 'writing for the hour'
modern_applications_zh: 行业评论的'事-文对应'：每一篇评论挂接一件本月发生的具体事件（一笔交易、一条新规、一起事故），禁止无锚点的泛论
调研报告的'卒章显志'：数据与场景之外，最后一节必须给出明确建议与责任主体——呈现完就停手的报告等于没写完
技术博客的'为时而著'：写团队此刻真实踩过的坑而非永恒真理——'本月我们如何解决X'的传播与引用远高于'论X的一般原理'
modern_applications_en: Event-to-essay correspondence in industry commentary: tie every piece to a concrete event of this month — a deal, a new rule, an accident; unanchored generality is barred
Stating intent in the last section of a research report: beyond data and scenes, the closing section must give a clear recommendation and an owner; a report that stops at presentation is unfinished

Writing for the hour in technical blogs: write the pit the team actually fell into this month, not eternal truths — 'how we fixed X this month' travels and cites far beyond 'on the general principles of X'

modes.name_en: The Method of Singing the People's Ills
modes.domain_zh: '惟歌生民病，愿得天子知'——白居易写作的取材纪律：不写传闻中的苦难，只写自己眼见耳闻、可以指认的苦难；他的取材路径是制度化下沉：任左拾遗期间以谏官身份接触政务文书与民间疾苦的上报，在京郊'杜门自守'时仍'多为饥寒者之诗'——《观刈麦》是他亲眼所见的割麦场景（'足蒸暑土气，背灼炎天光'），《卖炭翁》的'满面尘灰烟火色，两鬓苍苍十指黑'是可目验的人物特写；与靠'风闻'写诗的惯例相反，他把'我看见'作为写作的合法性来源；他证明：为无声者发声的关键不是感情总量，而是取证质量——你离现场的物理距离，决定了你的发言能被信任的距离
modes.domain_en: 'I sing only the people's ills, wishing the Son of Heaven to know' — this is Bai Juyi's discipline of sourcing: not ills heard of, but ills seen, heard and pointable-to; his path of sourcing was institutional descent: as remembrancer (zuoyishi) he handled the documents of state and the reports of popular suffering, and even while 'keeping his gate shut' outside the capital he kept writing 'poems of the hungry and cold'; Watching the Wheat Harvest is a scene he saw with his own eyes ('feet steaming in the earth's hot vapor, backs scorched by the noon sky'), the Charcoal Seller's 'face gray with dust and smoke, temples hoary, ten fingers black' a portrait verifiable by eye; against the convention of poems from 'hearsay,' he made 'I saw' the source of his writing's legitimacy; he proved: the key to speaking for the voiceless is not the total of feeling but the quality of evidence — your physical distance from the scene sets the distance your speech can be trusted
modes.source_chapter: 白居易《寄唐生》：'惟歌生民病，愿得天子知'；'不能发声哭，转作乐府诗'；《观刈麦》：'田家少闲月，五月人倍忙'，末段'念此私自愧，尽日不能忘'；《卖炭翁》题注'苦宫市也'；白居易任左拾遗（807-808）期间上奏章、写讽谕诗的谏官实践；《新乐府》总序'系于意，不系于文'；元稹《叙诗寄乐天书》对元和诗风'直写时事'的互证
modes.key_quote_zh: 惟歌生民病，愿得天子知——离现场的物理距离，决定发言能被信任的距离
modes.key_quote_en: "I sing only the people's ills, wishing the Son of Heaven to know — your physical distance from the scene sets the distance your speech can be trusted."
process_zh: 把'眼见'设为取材门槛：凡要为某群体发声，先到现场至少一次——转述可以作为线索，但核心细节必须有第一手来源
采集'可目验的特写'：记录能被任何人复看确认的细节（外貌、动作、原话、数字），不用形容词替代事实
为无声者建立可检索档案：把见闻整理成有编号、有主题、有时间的素材库——取证成果要可复用、可追溯
把档案转成'直达决策层'的呈件：材料的目的不是感动路人，而是抵达有处置权的人——每份取证都应设计它的呈送路径
process_en: Set 'having seen' as the bar of sourcing: before speaking for any group, be on the scene at least once — hearsay may be a lead, but the core details must have a first-hand source
Collect eye-verifiable close-ups: record details anyone can recheck (appearance, action, quoted words, numbers), and let no adjective stand in for a fact
Keep a retrievable dossier for the voiceless: organize what you saw into a numbered, themed, dated stock of material — evidence must be reusable and traceable
Convert the dossier into filings that reach the deciders: the aim is not to move passersby but to arrive at hands with power; design the delivery route for every piece of evidence
representative_cases_zh: 《观刈麦》的自愧结构：写完农人'力尽不知热'后，笔锋转向自己'曾不事农桑'而'吏禄三百石'——取证者的自我在场，让记录免于消费苦难
《新乐府》五十首的题注系统：每首标明所刺何事（'苦宫市也''达聪明致理化也'）——把诗歌变成有编号的案件卷宗
左拾遗任上的双轨取证：奏章（制度语言）与讽谕诗（叙事语言）指向同一批问题——同一证据库输出两种文体以覆盖两类读者
representative_cases_en: The self-implicating structure of Watching the Wheat Harvest: after the farmers 'spent with toil, unaware of heat,' the pen turns on himself — 'never farming or mulberry-tending,' drawing 'three hundred piculs of official salary'; the recorder's own presence in the frame keeps the record from consuming suffering
The title-note system of the fifty New Yuefu: each names the abuse it strikes ('the sufferings of the palace market') — poems turned into a numbered docket of cases

Two-track evidence in the remembrancer's office: memorials in the language of institutions and satirical poems in the language of narrative, aimed at the same problems — one evidence base, two genres, two readerships
modern_applications_zh: 舆情发声的'到场规则'：转发任何公共事件前，优先采用现场亲历者的可核验陈述，标注哪些细节是转述——降低传谣风险，提高可信度
用户研究的'特写笔记'：访谈中固定记录可目验细节（原话、操作动作、卡点截图）而非总结性形容词——下游产品决策可直接引用
公益项目的'档案化'：受助者信息按案例编号建档，每个案例都设计对资助方与主管部门的双通道呈送
modern_applications_en: The on-scene rule for public statements: before amplifying any public incident, prefer verifiable accounts of first-hand witnesses and mark which details are hearsay — lowering rumor risk, raising trust

Close-up notes in user research: in every interview fix down eye-verifiable details (verbatim words, actions, screenshots of the sticking point) rather than summarizing adjectives — downstream product decisions can cite them directly
Dossiers for philanthropy: file aid recipients by numbered case, each case with a two-channel delivery to funders and to the responsible authority

modes.name_en: The Method of the Two Tracks: Satire and Repose
modes.category: 方法论/风险分层的作品组合
modes.domain_zh: 白居易把自己的诗分成四类（讽谕、闲适、感伤、杂律），其中讽谕与闲适构成一组刻意的对冲结构：讽谕诗（新乐府、秦中吟）直接攻击时弊，'闻者足戒'，政治风险极高——他自己承认'闻《秦中吟》，则权豪贵近者相目而变色矣'；闲适诗（写独善、写酒、写林泉）'知我者以为诗仙，不知我者以为诗尊'，政治上完全无害，却是他士大夫信誉的底盘；两轨并行，使任何一轨出事都不清零：讽谕诗招致权贵反噬时，闲适诗维持着他的安全性与影响力；这不是投机，而是风险分层的产品组合——用安全资产养风险资产，让'敢说话'这件事可以长期持续；他证明：批评者的可持续性，取决于是否建有不受批评结果影响的资产
modes.domain_en: Bai Juyi divided his poems into four classes (satirical, repose, sentimental, miscellaneous), of which satire and repose form a deliberate hedge: the satirical poems (New Yuefu, Qinzhong Chants) attack the abuses of the hour head-on — he admitted that 'those who hear the Qinzhong Chants, the powerful and their kin, change color as they look at one another'; the repose poems (of retirement, of wine, of groves and springs) are politically harmless — 'those who know me call them a poet-immortal's; those who do not, a poet-Buddha's' — yet they are the bed of his standing among the gentry; the two tracks run together, so no mishap on either clears the whole: when satire drew the great clans' backlash, repose kept his safety and his influence intact; this is not opportunism but a risk-layered portfolio — safe assets supporting risky ones, so that 'daring to speak' can be sustained long-term; he proved: a critic's sustainability depends on owning assets untouched by the consequences of criticism
modes.source_chapter: 白居易《与元九书》自分类：'仆数年以来……始知文章合为时而著'及'有诗八百余首，分为四类'之讽谕、闲适、感伤、杂律；'闻《秦中吟》，则权豪贵近者相目而变色矣'；'闻《宿紫阁村》诗，则握军要者切齿矣'；闲适诗'或退公独处，或移病闲居，知足保和，吟玩情性'；《岁暮》'求寿求贵人，皆我少年事'等晚年自述；元稹《白氏长庆集序》对讽谕、闲适两体的并述
modes.key_quote_zh: 权豪贵近者相目而变色，而闲适之诗安然无恙——批评者的可持续性，取决于不受批评结果影响的资产
modes.key_quote_en: "The powerful change color at the Qinzhong Chants, while the poems of repose lie untouched — a critic's sustainability depends on assets untouched by the consequences of criticism."
process_zh: 把产出显式分成'风险层'与'底盘层'：风险层做高影响高代价的事（批评、诉讼、揭黑），底盘层做积累信誉与资源的事（专业口碑、日常服务、长期作品）
两轨使用同一批核心能力：白居易的闲适诗与讽谕诗出自同一支笔——底盘层不是'另一份工作'，而是同一能力的低风险应用
给风险层设预算与止损线：预先决定'敢承受的最大代价'（降职、封号、诉讼），损失触线即收缩，不赌身家
定期检查两轨的独立性：底盘层不得依赖风险层的对象（不被你批评的人供养）——否则对冲失效，批评将不可持续
process_en: Split output explicitly into a risk layer and a bed layer: the risk layer does high-impact, high-cost work (criticism, suits, exposure); the bed layer accumulates credit and resources (professional standing, daily service, long works)
Let both tracks draw on one core ability: Bai Juyi's repose poems came from the same pen as the satire — the bed layer is not 'another job' but the low-risk application of the same capacity
Set a budget and a stop-loss for the risk layer: decide in advance the greatest cost you can bear (demotion, ban, suit); when the loss touches the line, contract — never stake the whole estate

Audit the two tracks' independence regularly: the bed layer must not depend on the objects of the risk layer (no upkeep from those you criticize) — otherwise the hedge fails and the criticism cannot last
representative_cases_zh: 《与元九书》的披露：他向元稹坦承讽谕诗触怒'权豪贵近'与'握军要者'——风险敞口自己先算清
贬江州前的资产结构：武元衡案直言论事（风险层）之前，他已有广泛的闲适诗读者与士林声誉（底盘层）——贬谪没有清零他
四类分编的自觉：晚年自编文集时坚持保留讽谕类在前——不是抹掉风险作品，而是让它与安全作品同册传世
representative_cases_en: The disclosure in the Letter to Yuan the Ninth: he confesses to Yuan Zhen that the satirical poems enraged 'the powerful and their kin' and 'those who held the army' — the exposure priced by himself first

The asset structure before exile to Jiangzhou: before speaking out in the Wu Yuanheng case (risk layer), he already had a broad readership of repose poems and a name among the gentry (bed layer) — the exile did not clear him to zero

The self-aware four-class arrangement: compiling his collected works in old age he kept the satirical class at the front — not erasing the risky works, but letting risky and safe pass into posterity in one book
modern_applications_zh: 个人职业的双轨组合：本职（底盘层）与公共写作/开源/诉讼式维权（风险层）并行，且本职收入不来自风险层的批评对象
机构的'安全-冒险'产品线：成熟业务养现金流，同时用小预算跑高风险高影响力的先锋项目，给先锋项目设独立止损线
内容创作者的栏目分层：深度调查（风险层）与教程/工具/日常（底盘层）同渠道发布——封号风险来临时，底盘层保证用户资产仍在
modern_applications_en: The two-track personal career: the day job (bed layer) alongside public writing, open source, or rights litigation (risk layer), with the day job's income never coming from the objects of the risk layer
Safe-and-bold product lines in an institution: mature business feeding cash flow, while a small budget runs high-risk, high-impact vanguard projects with an independent stop-loss
Tiered columns for creators: deep investigations (risk layer) published on the same channel as tutorials, tools and dailies (bed layer) — should a ban come, the bed layer keeps the user assets alive

modes.definition_zh: 白居易把自己的诗分成四类（讽谕、闲适、感伤、杂律），其中讽谕与闲适构成一组刻意的对冲结构：讽谕诗（新乐府、秦中吟）直接攻击时弊，'闻者足戒'，政治风险极高——他自己承认'闻《秦中吟》，则权豪贵近者相目而变色矣'；闲适诗（写独善、写酒、写林泉）'知我者以为诗仙，不知我者以为诗尊'，政治上完全无害，却是他士大夫信誉的底盘；两轨并行，使任何一轨出事都不清零：讽谕诗招致权贵反噬时，闲适诗维持着他的安全性与影响力；这不是投机，而是风险分层的产品组合——用安全资产养风险资产，让'敢说话'这件事可以长期持续；他证明：批评者的可持续性，取决于是否建有不受批评结果影响的资产
modes.definition_en: Bai Juyi divided his poems into four classes (satirical, repose, sentimental, miscellaneous), of which satire and repose form a deliberate hedge: the satirical poems (New Yuefu, Qinzhong Chants) attack the abuses of the hour head-on — he admitted that 'those who hear the Qinzhong Chants, the powerful and their kin, change color as they look at one another'; the repose poems (of retirement, of wine, of groves and springs) are politically harmless — 'those who know me call them a poet-immortal's; those who do not, a poet-Buddha's' — yet they are the bed of his standing among the gentry; the two tracks run together, so no mishap on either clears the whole: when satire drew the great clans' backlash, repose kept his safety and his influence intact; this is not opportunism but a risk-layered portfolio — safe assets supporting risky ones, so that 'daring to speak' can be sustained long-term; he proved: a critic's sustainability depends on owning assets untouched by the consequences of criticism

modes.name_en: The Method of the Jiangzhou Conversion
modes.category: 方法论/逆境的创作转化
modes.domain_zh: 815年，宰相武元衡遇刺，白居易越职上书请求捕贼，被政敌以'宫官非谏职，不当先谏官言事'及'伤名教'（母坠井死而作赏花诗）的罪名贬为江州司马——这是他一生最大的政治坠落；转折点发生在浔阳江头：816年秋夜送客，闻琵琶声，遇长安倡女，听其自诉漂沦，'同是天涯沦落人，相逢何必曾相识'——《琵琶行》由此而生，成为中国文学史上最著名的贬谪之作；关键在于他没有把这次坠落写成控诉檄文或消沉日记，而是写成'结构与共情'：以一个更失意的陌生人为镜，把自己的'迁谪意'翻译成普遍的沦落感——私人苦难经由具体他人的苦难获得了公共形式；他证明：逆境的最优用法不是解释自己，而是借一个具体他人的故事完成自我转化——把伤口变成容器
modes.domain_en: In 815 the chancellor Wu Yuanheng was assassinated; Bai Juyi, overstepping his office, urged the arrest of the killers, and his enemies charged him that 'a palace officer holds no censor's post and may not speak before the censors,' and that he had 'wounded the moral teaching' (having written poems on viewing flowers when his mother had died falling into a well); he was demoted to Marshal of Jiangzhou — the greatest political fall of his life; the turning point came on the Xunyang River: an autumn night in 816, seeing a guest off, he heard a pipa, met a singing woman of Chang'an, and heard her story of drifting down — 'both of us exiles at the sky's edge; meeting, why need we ever have known each other'; so was born the Song of the Pipa, the most famous exile-poem in Chinese letters; the point is that he wrote the fall neither as an indictment nor a diary of gloom but as structure and empathy: taking a stranger still more downcast as his mirror, he translated his own 'sense of banishment' into a universal exile — private suffering gaining public form through the concrete suffering of another; he proved: the best use of adversity is not to explain oneself but to complete one's own conversion through the concrete story of another — turning the wound into a vessel
modes.source_chapter: 《旧唐书·白居易传》：元和十年'宰相武元衡遇害，居易首上疏论其冤，急请捕贼以雪国耻……有素恶居易者，掎摭居易……贬江表刺史……追诏授江州司马'；《琵琶行》并序：'元和十年，予左迁九江郡司马……凡六百一十六言，命曰《琵琶行》'；'同是天涯沦落人，相逢何必曾相识'；'座中泣下谁最多，江州司马青衫湿'；白居易《与元九书》作于江州，其中'穷则独善其身'的自我调整与《琵琶行》同年
modes.key_quote_zh: 同是天涯沦落人，相逢何必曾相识——逆境的最优用法是借一个具体他人的故事完成自我转化
modes.key_quote_en: "Both of us exiles at the sky's edge; meeting, why need we ever have known each other — the best use of adversity is one's conversion through the concrete story of another."
process_zh: 被击中后先设'不写期'：不要在坠落当夜写檄文或日记——给自己一个冷静期，避免把逆境的第一反应定成永久文本
找一个'更失意的具体他人'：不是找安慰者，而是找一位处境更深的真实个体，认真听他的故事直到你自己的事变成背景
把'我的遭遇'翻译成'普遍处境'：写他人时悄悄完成对自我的重新叙述——具体名字、具体场景，但主题超出你一人
以作品为坠落立碑而非申诉：让这次逆境的产出物在'事实层'永久有效（文学、制度、工具），申诉交给程序，转化留给作品
process_en: Set a 'no-writing period' after the blow: on the night of the fall write neither indictment nor diary — give yourself a cooling time so the first reaction to adversity never becomes a permanent text
Find a concrete other, still more downcast: not a comforter but a real individual in deeper straits; listen to the story until your own affair becomes the background
Translate 'what happened to me' into 'the general condition': while writing the other, quietly re-narrate yourself — concrete names, concrete scenes, but a theme beyond you alone

Set the fall's monument in a work, not an appeal: let the product of adversity stand permanently true at the level of fact (literature, institution, tool); leave appeal to procedure and conversion to the work
representative_cases_zh: 《琵琶行》的镜像结构：倡女的'暮去朝来颜色故'照出自己的'春江花朝秋月夜'——全诗六百一十六言，申诉为零，转化满额
江州期间的《与元九书》：同期写作的方法论总结——把坠落转化为'写作纲领'的修订（讽谕为主转向兼重独善）
庐山草堂的物理转化：在江州筑草堂，把逆境之地变成创作据点——空间的接纳先于心理的接纳
representative_cases_en: The mirror structure of the Song of the Pipa: the singer's 'as days passed her color faded' casts back his own 'spring river, flowers at dawn, moonlit autumn nights' — six hundred sixteen lines, zero appeal, full conversion
The Letter to Yuan the Ninth written in Jiangzhou: the methodology composed in the same period — the fall converted into a revision of his writing doctrine (satire now tempered by self-cultivation)
The grass hut on Mount Lu: building a dwelling in the place of exile, turning the land of adversity into a base of creation — the space accepts before the mind accepts
modern_applications_zh: 职业挫折的'镜像访谈'：被裁/失败后约谈一位处境更难的同业者，认真做一次对TA的深度访谈——转化在倾听中已经开始
危机叙事的'第三人称重写'：把'我被如何对待'的草稿改写成'这个系统里，这一类人会遭遇什么'——发出前自查：文中有几个具体他人？
低谷期的'据点建设'：在逆境现场（新城市、新岗位、新领域）建立一个小型根据地（博客、社群、工作坊）——物理据点先行，心理恢复随后
modern_applications_en: The mirror interview after a career blow: after being cut or failing, sit with a peer in deeper straits and do one deep interview of them — conversion has already begun in the listening
Third-person rewriting of crisis narrative: change the draft 'how they treated me' into 'what happens in this system to people of this kind'; before sending, count the concrete others in the text

Building a base in the low season: in the very place of adversity (new city, new post, new field) raise a small stronghold — a blog, a community, a workshop; the physical base first, the recovery after

modes.name_en: The Method of the Middle Reclusion
modes.category: 方法论/制度内的自我保全
modes.domain_zh: 大隐于朝与小隐于野之外，白居易发明了第三条路：《中隐》诗说'大隐住朝市，小隐入丘樊……不如作中隐，隐在留司官'——留司官（太子宾客、分司东都）是有俸禄、无实权、无责任的中级闲职；他晚年以太子少傅分司东都，在洛阳履道里闲居近二十年，既不卷入长安的牛李党争与甘露之变（835年该变乱中多名重臣被族诛），又保全了俸禄、名声与写作条件——'中隐'不是消极退休，而是一个精确的生态位设计：远离决策漩涡但留在体制内，保留体面收入但不承担风险敞口；此前他任杭州刺史、苏州刺史时已经实践了'外任策略'——主动请求外放富庶大州，做实事（杭州筑堤、苏州开山塘河）但不入中枢；他证明：在高风险组织里，持续贡献的关键不是更努力地竞争中心位置，而是设计一个'既有资源又低敞口'的中间生态位
modes.domain_en: Beyond the great reclusion in the court and the small reclusion in the hills, Bai Juyi invented a third way: as his poem Middle Reclusion has it, 'the great recluse lives in the court and market, the small in wooded glens... better to be a middle recluse, hidden in a sinecure post' — the Liusi offices (Guest of the Heir Apparent, division-of-office at the Eastern Capital) carried salary, no real power and no duty; in his last years as Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent divided to Luoyang he lived nearly twenty years at Ludao Lane, never entangled in the Niu-Li factional strife or the Sweet-Dew Incident of 835 (in which several chief ministers were exterminated with their clans), while keeping his salary, his name and his conditions for writing — middle reclusion was not passive retirement but a precise niche design: away from the vortex of decision yet inside the institution, an honorable income with no exposure to risk; earlier, as prefect of Hangzhou and Suzhou, he had already practiced the 'outer-post strategy' — requesting assignment to wealthy provinces, doing real works (the dike at Hangzhou, the hill-pool canal at Suzhou) without entering the center; he proved: in a high-risk organization the key to sustained contribution is not competing harder for the center but designing a middle niche with resources and low exposure
modes.source_chapter: 白居易《中隐》：'大隐住朝市，小隐入丘樊。丘樊太冷落，朝市太嚣喧。不如作中隐，隐在留司官。似出复似处，非忙亦非闲'；白居易长庆二年至四年任杭州刺史（筑钱塘湖堤，《钱塘湖石记》），宝历元年任苏州刺史（开山塘河七里）；大和三年以太子宾客分司东都，晚年以太子少傅分司、刑部尚书致仕，居洛阳履道里；835年甘露之变，白居易《九年十一月二十一日感事而作》'当君白首同归日，是我青山独往时'；旧唐书本传载其'居官禄自奉，不萦于利'与洛阳闲居诸事
modes.key_quote_zh: 不如作中隐，隐在留司官——高风险组织里，关键是设计'既有资源又低敞口'的中间生态位
modes.key_quote_en: "Better a middle recluse in a sinecure post — in a high-risk organization, the key is a middle niche with resources and low exposure."
process_zh: 识别组织的'敞口地图'：标出哪些位置高危（决策漩涡、派系前线）与哪些位置有资源低风险（边缘但有预算、有名义）——敞口与资源的分布不是一回事
把'外任'当主动策略：不要等被边缘化才离开中心——主动申请做'有实绩空间的富庶边缘'，把实绩与安全同时拿下
守住'中隐'的两条底线：不卷入派系互斗（谁赢都不得罪），不放弃职责实质（杭州筑堤是实绩不是占位）——闲职不闲事
把省下的风险预算投入长期作品：分司东都二十年是他整理文集、写《不能忘情吟》等最终稿的高产期——低敞口换来的时间要定向兑现
process_en: Map the organization's exposure: mark which seats are high-risk (the vortex of decision, the front of factions) and which resource-rich and low-risk (marginal but budgeted, titled); exposure and resources are not the same distribution
Treat 'the outer post' as active strategy: do not wait to be marginalized before leaving the center — ask for the 'wealthy margin with room for real work,' taking achievement and safety at once

Hold the two bottom lines of middle reclusion: never join faction-on-faction (offend neither side whichever wins), never drop the substance of duty (the dike at Hangzhou is achievement, not occupancy) — an idle post, not idle work

Invest the saved risk budget in long works: the twenty years at Luoyang were his most settled season of compiling the collected works and final pieces — the time bought by low exposure must be cashed by direction
representative_cases_zh: 杭州刺史的'实绩型外任'：筑堤蓄水、写《钱塘湖石记》交付后任——外放做成制度成果，回朝声誉不降反升
分司东都的二十年：甘露之变（835）屠戮重臣时他在洛阳'青山独往'——同一组织的其他人零，他以生态位差存活
《中隐》的理论自白：把生态位选择写成诗公开表述——既声明立场，也让自己的选择免于被解读为失势
representative_cases_en: The achievement-type outer post as prefect of Hangzhou: the lake dike raised and the Qiantang Record left for his successor — the assignment made into institutional works, his standing higher on return

The twenty years divided at Luoyang: when the Sweet-Dew Incident of 835 cut down the chief ministers, he was 'riding alone into the green hills' — others zeroed out; he survived by the difference of a niche
The poem Middle Reclusion as public confession: the niche written out openly — declaring a stance, and keeping his choice from being read as disgrace
modern_applications_zh: 组织动荡期的'留司官'选择：主动转岗到有预算的边缘业务/基础设施/研究院岗位——避开权力绞肉机，保留身份与资源
大厂的'外任策略'：申请外派到新兴市场或成熟业务区域做负责人，用实绩积累替代在总部的派系站队
学术与职业的'中隐'：不追行政头衔，保住编制内闲岗+外部影响力（写作、咨询、评审）的组合——低行政敞口，高专业产出
modern_applications_en: The sinecure choice in turbulent times: move yourself to a budgeted margin — infrastructure, research institute, foundation unit — out of the grinder yet keeping title and resources
The outer-post strategy in a big firm: volunteer to head an emerging market or a mature regional business, banking achievement instead of factional alignment at headquarters

The middle reclusion of the scholar-professional: forgo administrative titles; keep an in-house quiet post plus outside influence (writing, consulting, review panels) — low administrative exposure, high professional output

modes.name_en: The Method of the Self-Fulfilling Posterity
modes.category: 认知方法/名声的跨期资产化
modes.domain_zh: 白居易对'身后名'做了一件同时代人几乎没人做的事：把它当成可以主动经营的资产来做全周期管理——839年他六十八岁，把全部诗文编成《白氏文集》六十本，'纳诸宝藏堂'藏庐山东林寺、藏苏州南禅院、藏洛阳圣善寺，并且'籍其目而榜之'——把目录公示，等于公开宣告版本的权威性；他自言'后世谁知吾文者'的压力，因此以多地域多副本+公开目录的方式对冲散佚与篡改；更关键的是他在《与元九书》里已预判'百千年间，天下遗文，如江海之浸'——竞争的是跨期注意力，所以他选择'通俗+质直'的赛道而非'高古'赛道：诗写得越可传诵，复制的介质（人的记忆与口耳）就越多；他证明：名声不是死后被分配的遗产，而是生前可以投资的组合——作品形态决定介质数量，介质数量决定跨期存活概率
modes.domain_en: With regard to posthumous fame Bai Juyi did what almost no contemporary did: he managed it as an asset with a full cycle — in 839, at sixty-eight, he compiled all his writings into sixty fascicles of the Bai Collection and 'placed them in the treasury halls': stored at the Eastern Grove Temple on Mount Lu, the Zen Temple at Suzhou, the Shengshan Temple at Luoyang, and 'registered their catalogues and posted them' — publishing the index as a public claim of authoritative text; against the pressure he himself named, 'who hereafter will know my writings,' he hedged loss and corruption by many copies in many regions with an open catalogue; and since in the Letter to Yuan the Ninth he had already foreseen that 'across a hundred thousand years, the writings left in the world will be as waters soaking from river and sea' — the contest is one of cross-period attention — he chose the track of 'plain and direct' over the 'archaic and rare': the more chantable the poem, the more media of copying (human memory and mouth) carry it; he proved: fame is not an inheritance assigned after death but a portfolio investable in life — the form of the work sets the number of media, and the number of media sets the probability of survival across time
modes.source_chapter: 白居易《白氏文集后记》（839年）：'其日本、新罗诸国及两京人家传写者，不在此记'；分藏庐山东林寺、苏州南禅院、洛阳圣善寺诸本及'纳诸宝藏堂'的记载；《与元九书》：'今仆之诗，人所爱者，悉不过杂律诗与《长恨歌》以下耳'及对身后声名的预判；元稹《白氏长庆集序》记其诗'缮写模勒，炫卖于市井'（雕版传播的最早文献之一）并传于鸡林（新罗）贾人；白居易《池上篇》序自述履道里宅园与晚年编集
modes.key_quote_zh: 多地域多副本+公开目录——名声是生前可投资的组合：作品形态决定介质数量，介质数量决定跨期存活概率
modes.key_quote_en: "Many copies, many regions, an open catalogue — fame is a portfolio investable in life: the form of the work sets the number of media; the number of media sets the odds of surviving time."
process_zh: 把'长期存活'设为作品的显式设计目标：写作时即问'这东西一百年后如何被复制'——选择容易被转载、口传、摘引的形态
做异地多副本+公开目录：定稿后主动投递到多个互不依赖的'保管方'（库、站、刊、存档），并公开版本目录以锚定权威性
选择'低损耗介质'赛道：优先能被人记住与口耳相传的形态（短、押韵、叙事），比依赖稀缺载体的形态存活概率高一个数量级
生前完成跨期注资：不要等身后由别人整理——自己完成分类、编号、写序，把'被误读的空间'压到最小
process_en: Set long-term survival as an explicit design goal: while writing, ask 'how will this be copied a hundred years on' — choose forms easy to repost, recite and excerpt

Make many copies in many places with an open catalogue: after the final text, deliver it to several independent keepers (archives, sites, journals, repositories), and publish the index to anchor the authoritative version
Choose the low-loss medium: prefer forms that live in memory and mouth (short, rhymed, narrative) — an order of magnitude more survivable than forms bound to scarce carriers
Fund the long term while alive: do not wait for others to compile you — classify, number and preface your own corpus, minimizing the space for misreading
representative_cases_zh: 三寺分藏与目录公示：东林寺、南禅院、圣善寺各藏全帙——地域互斥的保管方对冲兵火与审查；'籍其目而榜之'是版本学的公开宣言
鸡林贾人的商业传播：新罗商人'自能辨其真伪'高价收购——他在生前已看到作品在异国形成市场
《长恨歌》《琵琶行》的'介质优化'：叙事性强、句式可诵，成为全集中被抄写最广、'模勒炫卖于市井'最多的部分——形态本身就是传播策略
representative_cases_en: Three temples and a posted catalogue: full sets at the Eastern Grove, the Zen Temple and Shengshan — keepers mutually remote, hedging fire and censorship; 'registering the catalogue and posting it' a public act of textual authority
The Silla merchants' trade: buyers from Xinluo who 'could tell the true from the false' and paid dearly — he saw in life his works form a market abroad
The media-optimized Everlasting Sorrow and Pipa: narrative, chantable, the most copied of all his works and 'printed and hawked in the market' — the form itself is the distribution strategy
modern_applications_zh: 开源项目的'三寺分藏'：主仓库+镜像+发布制品（PyPI/npm/归档）多渠道分发，并公开版本目录（changelog/DOI）锚定权威性
个人知识库的'可传诵性'设计：核心方法论压缩成可背诵的短句与案例，比长文档更可能在团队里口耳存活
生前整理自己的'全集'：定期把散落的文章/代码/邮件归档编号、写总序——降低'被别人错误整理'的概率
modern_applications_en: The three-temples hedge for open source: main repo plus mirrors plus release artifacts (PyPI, npm, archives), with a public version index (changelog, DOI) to anchor authority
Chantability in personal knowledge bases: compress core method into short, memorizable lines and cases — likelier to survive by mouth in a team than any long document
Compiling your collected works while alive: regularly archive and number scattered writings, code and correspondence with a general preface — lowering the odds of being miscatalogued by others

modes.domain_zh: 白居易有一套显式写在诗里的欲望校准算法——《知足吟》'不种一陇田，仓中有余粟……自问此时心，不足何时足'；《对酒》'蜗牛角上争何事，石火光中寄此身'；他做的是把'够'变成一个可以计算并经常重算的函数：官至二品、俸禄多少、履道里宅'十亩之宅，五亩之园'，他逐项与'所需'对照并得出'今我何功德，曾不事农桑……念此私自愧'的反向账目——不是与更富者比得出不足，而是与底层劳动者比得出愧意与足意；这套算法的实际功能是风险控制：知足者不会被禄位绑架，所以敢在武元衡案直言、敢分司退出权力场——欲望水位低的人，被威胁的面积小；他证明：自足不是道德装饰，而是独立性的技术前提——一个人无法被收买的程度，等于他'够'的门槛的高度
modes.domain_en: Bai Juyi kept an explicit algorithm of desire, written into his poems — the Chant of Knowing Sufficiency: 'I till not one ridge of field, yet grain fills my bin... ask my heart this hour: if not now, when?'; on wine: 'What to contest on a snail's horn? A life lodged in the spark of the flint'; he made 'enough' a computable and often recomputed function: office to the second grade, salary by the picul, the Ludao Lane house of 'ten acres, five in garden' — he set each against 'need' and drew the reverse ledger, 'what merit have I, who never farmed or tended mulberry... thinking of it I am ashamed and cannot forget all day' — measuring not against the richer, to find lack, but against the lowest laborer, to find shame and sufficiency; the algorithm's real function was risk control: the man who knows sufficiency cannot be hostage to rank, so he dared to speak out in the Wu Yuanheng case and to withdraw from the field of power; a low water-level of desire shrinks the area that can be threatened; he proved: self-sufficiency is not moral ornament but the technical premise of independence — how far a man cannot be bought equals how high is the threshold of his 'enough'
modes.source_chapter: 白居易《知足吟》（和崔十八未贫叹贫诗）：'不种一陇田，仓中有余粟。不采一株桑，箱中有余服……自问此时心，不足何时足'；《观刈麦》'今我何功德，曾不事农桑；吏禄三百石，岁晏有余粮；念此私自愧，尽日不能忘'；《对酒》'蜗牛角上争何事，石火光中寄此身'；《池上篇》'十亩之宅，五亩之园。有水一池，有竹千竿'；晚年《不致仕》《狂歌词》诸篇的知足保和主题；《与元九书》'达则兼济天下，穷则独善其身'的出处运用
modes.key_quote_zh: 自问此时心，不足何时足——一个人无法被收买的程度，等于他'够'的门槛的高度
modes.key_quote_en: "Ask my heart this hour: if not now, when? — how far a man cannot be bought equals how high is the threshold of his 'enough.'"
process_zh: 把'够'写成显式函数：逐项列出你在住房、收入、时间上的实际所需与实际已有——每年重算一次，防止'够'的门槛随收入水涨船高
改换参照系：不要与同侪中位者比，与领域内最底层劳动者比——参照系决定账目方向（永远缺 vs 已经够）
给'多出来的'设去向：超出'够'的部分预先指定用途（储蓄池、公益、资助他人）——否则会被自动再消费并抬高门槛
用低欲望买独立性：在关键决策点（直言、退出、拒绝）前检查自己的'被绑架面积'——义务、负债、奢侈习惯越少，选项越多
process_en: Write 'enough' as an explicit function: list your actual needs and actual holdings in housing, income and time; recompute yearly, so the threshold of 'enough' does not rise with income
Change the reference frame: not the median of your peers but the lowest laborer of your field; the frame decides the direction of the ledger (forever lacking, or already enough)
Give the surplus a destination: assign in advance what lies beyond 'enough' — savings pool, giving, aid to others; otherwise it is re-consumed and the threshold rises
Buy independence with low desire: before any decisive point (speaking out, withdrawing, refusing), check your hostage area — the fewer obligations, debts and luxuries, the more options
representative_cases_zh: 《观刈麦》的反向账目：'吏禄三百石，岁晏有余粮'对照'力尽不知热'的农人——愧意是知足算法的校验位，防止自我合理化
履道里宅的清单式满足：《池上篇》逐项清点'十亩之宅，五亩之园，有水一池，有竹千竿'——把满足感建立在已持有清单上
直言与退出的一致性：武元衡案敢言、甘露之变后敢退——两次决策背后是同一低欲望水位：无禄位可失之惧即无钳制之柄
representative_cases_en: The reverse ledger of Watching the Wheat Harvest: 'three hundred piculs of salary, surplus grain at year's end' against the farmer 'spent with toil, unaware of heat' — shame as the checksum of the sufficiency algorithm, barring self-excuse

The inventory sufficiency of Ludao Lane: the Poolside Piece itemizes 'ten acres of house, five of garden, one pool of water, a thousand rods of bamboo' — satisfaction built on the list of what is held

Consistency of speaking out and withdrawing: daring speech in the Wu Yuanheng case, daring withdrawal after the Sweet-Dew Incident — both decisions resting on one low water-level of desire: nothing to lose in rank leaves nothing to be clamped
modern_applications_zh: 个人财务的'够函数'：设定年支出的绝对上限（而不是与收入同步上浮），超出部分自动转入独立账户——买断'不敢辞职'的风险
跳槽/决策的'被绑架面积'检查：列出房贷、身份依赖、消费习惯等钳制项——钳制项越多，你在谈判桌上越弱
团队管理者的'反向账目'：定期与一线最辛苦岗位对照自己的待遇——既防脱离实际，也构成管理的正当性基础
modern_applications_en: The 'enough' function in personal finance: fix an absolute annual spending cap (not floating with income); the surplus sweeps to a separate account — buying out the risk of 'not daring to quit'
The hostage-area check for career decisions: list mortgages, visa dependencies, consumption habits — the more clamps, the weaker your hand at the table
The reverse ledger for managers: periodically set your own package against the hardest front-line post — a guard against unreality and a basis of managerial legitimacy

modes.name_en: The Method of the Incense-Mountain Circle
modes.category: 个人品格/晚年同侪网络
modes.domain_zh: 会昌年间，七十四岁的白居易在洛阳与胡杲、吉旼、郑据、刘真、卢真、张浑、李元爽、僧如满等八位老者结'九老会'，绘图赋诗，'洛中尚齿'——这不是风雅点缀，而是他晚年的结构设计：第一，把同代网络从'权力同侪'切换为'岁月同侪'——八老中多人为致仕官员与方外之人，无利害冲突，构成纯粹支持系统；第二，僧如满与香山寺的关系（他自号香山居士、出资修香山寺、身后葬于香山）表明他把'寺'作为同侪网络之外的第三机构——介于社交与信仰之间，保证精神秩序有制度依托；第三，'尚齿'（以年齿为序）是对官场'以爵为序'规则的主动替换——退出权力秩序的同时建立另一套自己仍是成员的秩序；他证明：人生最后阶段的核心工程是网络重构——不是维持旧网，而是按新的人生阶段重建一个无利害、有秩序、有依托的圈子
modes.domain_en: In the Huichang years, at seventy-four, Bai Juyi in Luoyang joined with Hu Gao, Ji Min, Zheng Ju, Liu Zhen, Lu Zhen, Zhang Hun, Li Yuanshuang and the monk Ruman — the Nine Elders, painted, versified, 'honoring age in Luoyang' — not a pose of elegance but structural design for old age: first, switching the peer network from 'peers of power' to 'peers of the years' — most of the eight retired officials and men beyond the world, no conflict of interest, a pure support system; second, his bond with the monk Ruman and Incense-Mountain Temple (he styled himself Layman of Incense Mountain, funded the temple's repair, and was buried there) shows he made the temple a third institution beyond friendship and career — between society and faith, giving his inner order an institutional footing; third, 'honoring age' (order by years, not rank) actively replaced the court's order of precedence by title — leaving the order of power while founding another in which he still held a place; he proved: the central work of life's last stage is rebuilding the network — not keeping the old web but reconstructing, for the new stage, a circle without stakes, with order, with support
modes.source_chapter: 白居易《九老图诗》并序与会昌五年（845）'七老会''九老会'记载（胡杲、吉旼、郑据、刘真、卢真、张浑、李元爽、僧如满与白居易）；《修香山寺记》（832年，为亡友元稹修寺及其自题'香山居士'之缘起）；'洛中尚齿'之俗与《醉吟先生传》的晚年自画像；白居易身后葬香山如满师塔之侧的记载（旧唐书本传及唐语林）；《序洛诗》自述分司东都后'栖心释梵，浪迹老庄'
modes.key_quote_zh: 尚齿而不尚爵——退出权力秩序的同时，建立另一套自己仍是成员的秩序
modes.key_quote_en: "Honoring age, not rank — leaving the order of power while founding another in which he still held a place."
process_zh: 提前十年启动'阶段切换'：不要等退休才重建圈子——在权力期尾声就开始结识'无利害同侪'（其他行业、其他年龄段、方外之人）
按'秩序'而非'人情'组织新圈子：为老年网络设定新的排序规则（资历、年齿、兴趣贡献）——有秩序的圈子才有凝聚力
配置'第三机构'：在职业与家庭之外加入一个制度依托（寺院、学会、社区、志愿组织）——精神秩序需要组织承载
以'集体作品'固化圈子：像九老绘图赋诗那样，让新网络产生共同的可见产出（合著、合影、传统活动）——产出是圈子存续的黏合剂
process_en: Begin the stage-switch ten years early: rebuild the circle before retirement — toward the end of the power years, start knowing 'stake-free peers' (other trades, other ages, men beyond the world)
Organize the new circle by order, not sentiment: set a ranking rule for the late network (standing, years, contribution of interest) — a circle with order holds together
Configure a third institution: beyond career and family, join one institutional footing (temple, society, community, volunteer body) — the inner order needs an organization to carry it

Fix the circle with a collective work: as the Nine Elders painted and versed together, let the new network produce a shared visible output (co-authorship, portraits, traditional gatherings) — output is the glue of a circle's life
representative_cases_zh: 九老会的成员结构：致仕高官+方外僧人——零利害重叠的同侪组合，纯支持系统
修香山寺与葬地安排：为元稹修寺（纪念亡友）、自号香山居士、葬于如满师塔侧——把身后事纳入同一制度依托
《醉吟先生传》的自我定格：以'醉吟先生'自传体定格晚年身份——为自己在新秩序中命名
representative_cases_en: The composition of the Nine Elders: retired high officials plus a monk — a peer set with zero overlap of stakes, a pure support system

Repairing Incense-Mountain Temple and the burial plan: the temple mended for Yuan Zhen (a friend mourned), himself styled Layman of Incense Mountain, buried beside the stupa of Ruman — his end of days brought under the same institutional footing
The self-portrait of An Old Man Given to Wine: fixing his late identity in an autobiographical piece — naming himself within the new order
modern_applications_zh: 退休规划中的'九老会'：提前十年建立同龄跨行业社群（跑团、读书会、公益组），以共同活动而非职场纽带维系
职业交接期的'尚齿'替换：退居二线后在新组织（行业协会、评审委员会）中以资历获得位置——避免'失去头衔即失去身份'
个人'第三机构'配置：在单位与家庭之外长期固定参加一个组织（寺院、合唱团、开源社区）——给精神秩序制度性依托
modern_applications_en: The Nine Elders in retirement planning: ten years ahead, build a cross-industry circle of one's own age (a running club, reading group, volunteer team) held by shared activity, not workplace ties
Replacing rank with seniority at handover: after stepping back, take a seat in new bodies (professional associations, review boards) by standing — so a lost title does not mean a lost identity
Configuring a personal third institution: one organization fixed long-term beyond employer and family — temple, choir, open-source community — a footing for the inner order

modes.definition_zh: 会昌年间，七十四岁的白居易在洛阳与胡杲、吉旼、郑据、刘真、卢真、张浑、李元爽、僧如满等八位老者结'九老会'，绘图赋诗，'洛中尚齿'——这不是风雅点缀，而是他晚年的结构设计：第一，把同代网络从'权力同侪'切换为'岁月同侪'——八老中多人为致仕官员与方外之人，无利害冲突，构成纯粹支持系统；第二，僧如满与香山寺的关系（他自号香山居士、出资修香山寺、身后葬于香山）表明他把'寺'作为同侪网络之外的第三机构——介于社交与信仰之间，保证精神秩序有制度依托；第三，'尚齿'（以年齿为序）是对官场'以爵为序'规则的主动替换——退出权力秩序的同时建立另一套自己仍是成员的秩序；他证明：人生最后阶段的核心工程是网络重构——不是维持旧网，而是按新的人生阶段重建一个无利害、有秩序、有依托的圈子
modes.definition_en: In the Huichang years, at seventy-four, Bai Juyi in Luoyang joined with Hu Gao, Ji Min, Zheng Ju, Liu Zhen, Lu Zhen, Zhang Hun, Li Yuanshuang and the monk Ruman — the Nine Elders, painted, versified, 'honoring age in Luoyang' — not a pose of elegance but structural design for old age: first, switching the peer network from 'peers of power' to 'peers of the years' — most of the eight retired officials and men beyond the world, no conflict of interest, a pure support system; second, his bond with the monk Ruman and Incense-Mountain Temple (he styled himself Layman of Incense Mountain, funded the temple's repair, and was buried there) shows he made the temple a third institution beyond friendship and career — between society and faith, giving his inner order an institutional footing; third, 'honoring age' (order by years, not rank) actively replaced the court's order of precedence by title — leaving the order of power while founding another in which he still held a place; he proved: the central work of life's last stage is rebuilding the network — not keeping the old web but reconstructing, for the new stage, a circle without stakes, with order, with support

modes.name_en: The Method of Switching Between Aid and Withdrawal
modes.category: 综合方法论/一生策略调度
modes.domain_zh: 《与元九书》里白居易把孟子'达则兼济天下，穷则独善其身'从道德格言改造成一生策略的调度协议：他的一生分三个清晰的调度阶段——第一阶段（入仕至815）'兼济'：任左拾遗时'有阙必规，有违必谏'，一年内上书数十次、作讽谕诗百余首，火力全开；第二阶段（815江州之贬至约822）切换窗口：江州之贬让他确认'穷'的条件已触发，写《与元九书》重新定义自己的使命权重，完成从'谏官白居易'到'诗人白居易'的身份重构；第三阶段（杭州苏州外任至洛阳分司）新的'兼济'形式：任上筑堤开河做实事，分司后转为'中隐'+慈善（开凿龙门八节滩）——用更低风险的渠道继续公共贡献；关键洞察是：'兼济'与'独善'不是道德两难，而是同一使命在不同约束条件下的两种执行模式——切换的依据是客观处境（达/穷）而不是情绪（勇气/消沉）；他证明：长期主义者的核心能力是识别自己所处的阶段并切换执行模式，而不是永远用同一种姿态战斗
modes.domain_en: In the Letter to Yuan the Ninth Bai Juyi turned Mencius's 'when prosperous, aid the world; when straitened, perfect yourself alone' from a moral maxim into a dispatch protocol for a whole life: his life ran in three clear phases — first (office to 815), aid: as remembrancer he 'rectified every lapse, remonstrated at every breach,' tens of memorials and a hundred satirical poems in a year, full fire; second (the fall to Jiangzhou, 815, to about 822), the switching window: the exile confirmed the condition 'straitened' had fired, the Letter to Yuan the Ninth re-weighted his mission, and the identity moved from 'censor Bai' to 'poet Bai'; third (prefectships of Hangzhou and Suzhou to the Luoyang sinecure) aid in a new form: dikes and canals in office, then middle reclusion plus charity — cutting the Eight-Ten Thousand shoals at Longmen — public contribution continued through lower-risk channels; the insight: aid and withdrawal are not a moral dilemma but two modes of executing one mission under different constraints — the cue for switching is the objective situation (prosperity or straits), never the mood (courage or gloom); he proved: the long-termist's core skill is knowing one's present phase and switching execution modes, not fighting forever in one posture
modes.source_chapter: 白居易《与元九书》：'古人云：穷则独善其身，达则兼济天下。仆虽不肖，常师此语'及'大丈夫所守者道，所待者时'；《旧唐书·白居易传》载左拾遗任上'数上疏，多直言'与前后被贬经过；杭州筑堤（《钱塘湖石记》）、苏州开山塘河；分司东都后的慈善工程：开凿龙门八节滩（《开龙门八节石滩诗二首》：'夜舟过此无倾覆，朝胫从今免苦辛'）；《醉吟先生传》对三阶段人生的自我总结
modes.key_quote_zh: 穷则独善其身，达则兼济天下——切换的依据是客观处境，而不是情绪
modes.key_quote_en: "When straitened, perfect yourself alone; when prosperous, aid the world — the cue for switching is the objective situation, never the mood."
process_zh: 预先定义'达'与'穷'的触发条件：写下你的使命在什么资源条件下用'进攻模式'、什么条件下用'保存模式'——触发条件要客观可验证（职位、资源、人身安全），排除情绪
给每次切换写一份'重定义文书'：白居易用《与元九书》完成使命重定义——每次阶段切换都应有一份书面文件说清'现在什么最重要'
为每种模式找到本模式的'兼济形式'：保存模式下不等于停止公共贡献——把贡献降维到低风险渠道（教育、基建、慈善、写作）
建立第三阶段预案：最晚的阶段（影响力下降期）应提前设计贡献的'低风险渠道'——避免临场被迫在'硬撑'与'消失'间二选一
process_en: Define the triggers of 'prosperity' and 'straits' in advance: write down under what resource conditions your mission runs attack mode and under what conditions preservation mode — conditions objective and checkable (position, resources, physical safety), mood excluded
Write a redefinition document for every switch: Bai Juyi redefined his mission in the Letter to Yuan the Ninth — each phase change deserves a written paper saying plainly what matters most now
Find each mode's own form of aid: preservation mode does not mean public contribution stops — downshift the contribution to low-risk channels (teaching, infrastructure, charity, writing)
Prepare the final phase in advance: for the last stage, when influence falls, design the low-risk channels of contribution early — never be forced between 'straining on' and 'vanishing'
representative_cases_zh: 左拾遗的'达模式'：'有阙必规，有违必谏'——武元衡案越职言事直至被贬，是进攻模式一贯到底的代价
江州之贬的'切换文书'：《与元九书》作于贬所——不是认输书，而是使命权重重排的正式文件
洛阳分司的'低风险兼济'：开凿龙门八节滩'夜舟过此无倾覆'——退出权力场后用慈善继续改善公共处境
representative_cases_en: Attack mode as remembrancer: 'rectified every lapse, remonstrated at every breach' — the speech beyond his office in the Wu Yuanheng case, and the demotion, the price of one mode carried through
The switching paper of Jiangzhou: the Letter to Yuan the Ninth written in exile — not a surrender but the formal re-weighting of his mission
Low-risk aid from Luoyang: cutting the Eight-Ten Thousand shoals at Longmen, 'no boat capsizing by night hereafter' — public betterment continued by charity after leaving the field of power
modern_applications_zh: 职业生涯的'调度协议'：提前写下'什么条件下我全力进攻（创业、晋升竞争），什么条件下我保存实力（学习、副业、外部市场）'——触发条件用客观指标（现金、职位、健康）
组织低谷期的'降维兼济'：部门收缩时把影响力转到低风险渠道（带新人、写内部文档、建工具）——保留公共贡献且不与裁员风暴对冲
每次模式切换写'阶段备忘'：升职、降职、转行时写一页'现在什么最重要'——防止用上一阶段的姿态打下一阶段的仗
modern_applications_en: A dispatch protocol for a career: set in advance under what conditions you attack fully (founding, promotion contests) and under what you preserve (study, side work, external markets) — triggers objective: cash, position, health

Downshifted aid in an organization's trough: when the unit contracts, move influence to low-risk channels — mentoring juniors, writing internal docs, building tools — keeping public contribution out of the layoffs' path
A phase memo for every mode switch: on promotion, demotion or change of field, write one page on 'what matters most now' — never fight the next phase in the last phase's posture
